title: Rows Per Field Calculator: Fit and Leftover
description: Work out how many crop rows fit across a field width with the Rows Per Field Calculator — row count and unused width, before headlands. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, a 600 ft field at 30-inch row spacing fits exactly 240 rows with nothing left over — while 36-inch rows in a 500 ft field give 166 rows and 2 awkward feet of leftover.
quick_answer: The Rows Per Field Calculator divides a field or bed width by the row spacing to give the number of rows that fit and the unused width remaining. Enter the width and spacing and read the fit — the first-pass planting layout, before headlands and machinery turns take their share.
